notes.title: BY THE SEA update
notes.content:
We bring you a new update that was originally supposed to be paid DLC, but in the end we decided to offer [b]the new sea scenes[/b] to all our players!

The update offers [b]6 new scenes[/b] with a total length of over 11 minutes!

- By the sea
- Sunset
- Quiet street
- View of the old town
- Small bay
- Sea view

After today's update, the game now offers 24 scenes!
